title: 'Section 6.1 — Dynamic effects'
format: html

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, scales, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Table 2

```{r}
m3_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df        = data,
  outcome   = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group     = "id",
  time      = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects   = 3,
  placebo   = 3
)
print(m3_nc)
```

## Figure 1

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
col_pre     <- "#0E8A5F"
col_post    <- "#D9461E"
col_ref     <- "#1F2422"
col_line    <- "#C3C3BD"
col_ink     <- "#6E6E68"
col_surface <- "#FFFFFF"

es_cols <- c(placebo = col_pre, reference = col_ref, effect = col_post)

rows <- function(mat, sign, type) {
  tibble(
    relative_time = sign * seq_len(nrow(mat)),
    type          = type,
    estimate      = mat[, "Estimate"],
    lb_ci         = mat[, "LB CI"],
    ub_ci         = mat[, "UB CI"]
  )
}

es <- bind_rows(
  rows(m3_nc$results$Placebos, -1, "placebo"),
  tibble(relative_time = 0, type = "reference", estimate = 0,
         lb_ci = NA_real_, ub_ci = NA_real_),
  rows(m3_nc$results$Effects, 1, "effect")
) |>
  mutate(
    type = factor(type, levels = c("placebo", "reference", "effect")),
    lab  = if_else(type == "effect", number(estimate, 0.001), NA_character_)
  ) |>
  arrange(relative_time)

subtitle <- sprintf(
  "Effects jointly zero: p = %.3f   ·   placebos jointly zero: p = %.3f",
  m3_nc$results$p_jointeffects, m3_nc$results$p_jointplacebo
)

p_es <- ggplot(es, aes(relative_time, estimate, colour = type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#DCDCD5", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#DCDCD5", linewidth = 0.5,
             linetype = "22") +
  geom_line(colour = col_line, linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "round") +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lb_ci, ymax = ub_ci),
                 linewidth = 1.1, lineend = "round", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = type), shape = 21, colour = col_surface,
             size = 3.8, stroke = 1.3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ub_ci, label = lab), vjust = -1.1, size = 3,
            fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = es_cols, breaks = c("placebo", "effect"),
                      labels = c("Placebos (pre)", "Effects (post)"),
                      drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = es_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = es$relative_time,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.45)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.10, 0.16))) +
  labs(subtitle = subtitle,
       x        = "Quarters relative to the treatment change   (0 = last quarter before the change)",
       y        = "Effect on registrations per 1,000") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = col_surface, colour = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = col_surface, colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#EDEDE7", linewidth = 0.35),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = col_ink,
                                 margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = col_ink),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 9, colour = col_ink),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.direction     = "horizontal",
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = col_ink),
    legend.margin        = margin(t = 2, b = 6),
    legend.box.spacing   = unit(0, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 12, 16)
  )

dir.create(here("figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(here("figures", "figure_1_event_study.png"), p_es,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = col_surface)

p_es
```
